description: Get one wallet's full The Standard Reserve (TSR) position on Robinhood Chain: every live Charter it holds (a burned or revoked Charter is not held, and a wallet with none has no dormancy clock) with that Charter's pending owed STANDARD (the last-indexed checkpoint, not a live re-read), a total-owed sum, a summary exit quote (the pro-rata resolution-fee math the exit-quote route itself owns, summed across every Charter's full open-Branch count), the wallet's dormancy record with an estimated time until it becomes reportable for the dormancy bounty, and each Charter's license-purchase headroom for today. Each Charter and the wallet as a whole also carry a `stimulus` object for the one-time charter stimulus: STANDARD claimable now and already claimed. The claim deadline is in the `deadline` field of the stimulus object. The charter's current owner claims it. Charter transfers are disabled on chain today, so that is the wallet holding the charter. A full exit forfeits an unclaimed stimulus (confirmed by simulation). Fields ending in _raw are 18-decimal integers as strings; divide by 1e18 for token amounts. charter_drops rolls the same launchpad drop shares up over every Charter: claimable, still locked (open branches, or an at_exit drop that pays only when the charter has none), and how many Charters should call noteOwner before closing their last branch. Burned Charters the wallet last owned stay in charter_drops, because a noted burned Charter can still claim; one with no owner note cannot, so its share is reported as unclaimable, never as claimable. Drops stay claimable until swept, even past their expires_at. Values come in launch tokens, then pair stock, then ETH when priced. When the wallet held a charter that was revoked for dormancy and has a refund, burned_charter_claim shows that allocation: claimable now, claimed or not, the deadline and which charters it covers. It is one amount for the wallet, and only this wallet can claim it. The block is absent otherwise.
name: 1s_std_wallet
title: TSR Wallet Position
